From the logs:
- Bulk total PE: -1679.86275358002 eV

The surface configuration creates two surfaces (top and bottom) when we remove periodicity in the z-direction.

Surface energy formula:
γ = (E_surface - E_bulk) / (2 × Area)

Where:
- E_surface = -1631.81097242534 eV
- E_bulk = -1679.86275358002 eV
- Area = 407.8238886225 Å²
- Factor of 2 accounts for two surfaces created
